entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to make a return. I'm just looking at the box now, it's the VeloBand Pulse. I'm a bit overwhelmed with everything.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your full name or the order number to pull up your account?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your account here. VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 5th. That was 15 days ago. I do need to let you know that this specific device has a 10-day return policy due to hygiene protocols.
Ten days? Oh, no. I thought it was 90 days... like the shoes I bought last year. I'm so confused, the website... I just didn't see that. Everything has been such a blur. Can't you just help me?

I understand the different policies can be confusing, and I want to help. To see what our options are, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's nothing like that. The band is probably fine. It's just... we had a serious family emergency right after it arrived. My husband's military deployment got moved up unexpectedly.
I'm sorry to hear that. That must be very difficult.

It was. And then, in the middle of all that chaos, my son was in an accident and had to be rushed to the hospital. He needed emergency surgery. The box just sat there, completely forgotten. We've been living at the hospital for the last two weeks.
Sarah, I am so sorry you and your family are going through all of that. Please, don't worry about the 10-day policy. Given the circumstances, that is the last thing you need to be concerned with.
So... you can help?

Absolutely. We can certainly make a one-time exception for this. I can authorize a full refund back to your original payment method. I'm generating a prepaid return label to send to your email right now. You can just drop it in the mail whenever you have a moment.
Really? Oh, thank you so much! That is such a relief. You have no idea.

It's truly my pleasure. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. To thank you for your loyalty, and on behalf of all of us at VeloFit, I've added a $50 store credit to your account for you to use anytime. I hope your son has a swift and full recovery.
Wow, Charlie, you really didn't have to do that. That's so kind. Thank you, for everything.
You are very welcome, Sarah. The email with the return label should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else at all I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and please take care.
